dedupe_keys.name: geospatial electric power grid datasets for mazoon electricity company in oman

description: Md. Shadman Abid and Razzaqul Ahshan at Sultan Qaboos University publish anonymised locations of Mazoon Electricity Company infrastructure in Oman. The documented CSV tables in ZIP archives contain 507,251 poles, 385,050 service points and 23,623 substations across four governorates and seventeen districts. Fields include district and governorate labels plus coordinate columns. For security, all Omani coordinates are scaled to the interval zero to one; they cannot be used as true UTM locations despite the column names. The February 2025 release is free under CC BY 4.0. It also packages 56,283 Nigerian grid-component locations attributed to HDX, which should not be counted as a separately new upstream dataset. The Oman tables can inform asset-density and synthetic spatial-network simulations, subject to understanding the scaling and reconstructing connectivity. The provider's claim that relative spatial relationships are preserved was not tested. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the Mazoon release, and the archives were not opened.
